Name: Eddie Munson from Stranger Things Replaces Sebastian
Author: acidicbarkbeast
Description:
This is not only the very first mod I've ever made but also one I made in approximately 3 days with very little coding knowledge. The full extent of the mod is currently untested in that I have not played through all of Sebastian's heart events and have not reached the Island, though the main sprites are working fine so I don't see why the others wouldn't. I am not a coder, [b]please report any issues if found!
[/b]
[b]This mod includes;[/b]
- Full, non-seasonal recolors of portraits
- Full, non-seasonal recolors of overworld sprites
- Edited "Cursor" and "emoji" sprites

[b]What you may do with the mod;
[/b]- Edit the code, idc
- Revamp the mod art (please credit if posted)

If using this mod with the Slightly Cuter Aesthetic mod, you'll have to set Slightly Cuter Sebastian to false in the content.json so there is no interference.
